acceptance_criteria: Scroll-snap sections work correctly with dynamic perspective changes on each snap.
Profile cards display monospaced typography and shadow casting, with visible focus rings on keyboard navigation.
Inline form validation is implemented with accessible error messages for data entry.
Component adheres to WCAG AA color contrast standards.
Prefers-reduced-motion users have non-essential animations disabled.
